note: Unreal frame of the module: x out of the dock wall, y = -spec y, z up; cm. See README "Motion".
RamCurve: p = frac(t/Period); fall = 1 for p<0.08, 1-smoothstep(0.08,0.6,p), 0 until 0.88, ((p-0.88)/0.12)^2; blow lands at p=0
MovingChannels: R ram, G flywheel (with axle and crank pin), B yoke and rod, A chute link (A also = primer)
HotChannels: A kind; R spout run (index into SpoutDirs); G 1 on the billet top

CustomPrimitiveData.16: MotionStopped (the faction MF_BF_MotionClock): unset/0 runs, 1 holds the rest pose and dims the hot metal

ParameterCollection: MPC_BF_OW_Forge: Period, StrikesPerBillet, SquashFraction (shared by both materials and the Sparks timer)
